questions.prompt: What basic claim does Chapter 13 make about schooling?
choices: It is only about direct skill transfer
It can signal traits and serve broader institutional functions
It has no real learning value at all

explanation.gentle: The chapter treats school as more than pure instruction.
explanation.direct: Its main move is to widen schooling into signaling plus broader institutional roles.

questions.prompt: What traits may school signal according to the chapter?
choices: Only creativity and kindness
Intelligence, conscientiousness, and conformity
Nothing beyond course content

explanation.gentle: The chapter says school can make these traits socially legible.
explanation.direct: Education may certify ability, discipline, and fit, not only learned facts.
explanation.competitive: The credential can advertise brains, discipline, and compliance.

questions.prompt: Why are babysitting and networking included in the chapter's model of education?
choices: Because they widen school beyond pure instruction
Because they replace every teaching function
Because they happen only outside formal education

explanation.gentle: The chapter says school can structure time and connect people as well as teach.
explanation.direct: These functions help explain schooling's broader institutional role.
explanation.competitive: School manages time and networks, not just lessons.

questions.prompt: A company values a degree mainly as a proxy for persistence and fit. Which chapter idea is most visible?
choices: Schooling can function as a socially legible signal of traits
Only coursework knowledge matters in credentials
Degrees matter only because of networking

explanation.gentle: The degree is being read for what it says about the student, not only the lessons.
explanation.direct: The credential is working as trait certification in addition to any content marker.
explanation.competitive: The stamp is filtering the person, not just the syllabus.

questions.prompt: Why might a school advisory period matter in this chapter even when little academic content is taught?
choices: Because school can shape conformity and domesticate behavior as well as instruct
Because non-academic periods are irrelevant to education
Because only networking matters there

explanation.gentle: The chapter includes norm-shaping and routine-training in what school can do.
explanation.direct: Advisory can matter because schooling also forms habits and institutional behavior.
explanation.competitive: The period can train the script, not just the lesson.

School may signal traits beyond content
School is only pure skill transfer with no other institutional roles

explanation.gentle: The chapter gives education a wider role than instruction alone.

questions.prompt: How does Chapter 13 grow out of Chapter 12 on charity?
choices: It moves from visible giving signaling the donor to visible schooling signaling the student
It abandons signaling and focuses only on knowledge
It treats education and charity as unrelated

explanation.gentle: After charity, the book turns to school as another socially legible investment.
explanation.direct: Education continues the signaling story by shifting from moral display to trait certification.
explanation.competitive: The visible investment moves from gift to credential.

questions.prompt: Why might families value a school partly for the people a student will meet there?
choices: Because networking is one of the chapter's widened functions of schooling
Because networking replaces all learning
Because only social life matters in school choice

explanation.gentle: The chapter says schools can create socially valuable connections as well as teach.
explanation.direct: Networking helps explain why education choices can matter beyond classroom content.
explanation.competitive: The school can sell access along with lessons.

questions.prompt: Why does the chapter insist that school can teach while also serving signaling and social-management roles?
choices: Because real learning and broader institutional functions can coexist in one system
Because signaling disappears whenever real learning occurs
Because education never shapes behavior

explanation.gentle: The chapter's main tension is coexistence, not replacement.
explanation.direct: Instruction can remain real even while schooling also certifies traits and manages people socially.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest bridge from Chapter 13 into Chapter 14 on medicine?
choices: If school can mix real function with visible signals, medicine may also mix healing with visible caring and sacrifice
Medicine matters only when education disappears
School and medicine belong to unrelated parts of the book

explanation.gentle: The next chapter asks how visible care signals can ride alongside real treatment.
explanation.direct: Medicine becomes the next mixed-motive domain where real function and visible signals coexist.
explanation.competitive: After credentials signal the student, treatment signals care.
